messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Apixaban is used to lower the risk of stroke and blood clots.
It is used in adults with a heart rhythm disorder called atrial fibrillation.
The atrial fibrillation is not caused by a heart valve problem.
Apixaban is used in adults to treat blood clots in the legs (DVT) or lungs (PE).
Apixaban is used to lower the risk of blood clots happening again.
This risk reduction occurs after you have received treatment for blood clots.
Apixaban is used in adults after hip or knee replacement surgery.
It is used to prevent clots that can occur in the legs or in the lungs.
Clots in the legs are known as deep vein thrombosis (DVT).
Clots in the lungs are known as pulmonary embolism (PE).
Apixaban is used in children from birth to less than 18 years of age.
It is used to treat blood clots in the legs (DVT) or lungs (PE).
It is used to lower the risk of clots happening again.
This is done after receiving treatment for at least 5 days.
Apixaban is not approved for use in children who weigh less than 5.7 pounds (2.6 kg).
Apixaban may also be used for purposes not listed in this medication guide.
Triplet: ["Apixaban", "prevents", "clots in lungs"]

The relation 'prevents' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is used to prevent the occurrence of the medical condition specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'should be avoided with': Patients taking the subject drug should avoid the substance or activity specified by the object entity.
E. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
